_about: The N360 customer risk model (docs/21_RISK_MODEL.md). Every feature, weight, anchor, hard red and model setting is here; code never holds a threshold. All values are PROPOSED until Ryan approves and the backtest supports them.
_label_about: Contracted churn and downsell happen at a renewal. The model answers: will this customer churn or downsell at its next renewal, for customers whose renewal is within horizon_days (or unknown). Snapshots further out are scored for display but not used to train or judge the model.
_features_about: risk = clamp((value - good) / (bad - good), 0, 1): 0 at or better than good, 1 at or worse than bad (works in either direction). weight = share inside its dimension. pit = can be computed as it stood on a past date (point-in-time); features that cannot are left out of training and backtests and used only for today's score.

open_churn_risks.title: Open churn risks in the register

_context_about: Context features are stored and shown but do not score risk: they decide urgency and money.
_hard_red_about: Exceptions (Gainsight's term): any one makes the band 'at risk' and caps health at cap_health, whatever the weights say.

rules.label: Renewal lost or omitted in Salesforce
Open churn risk in the register
A VA silent for 5+ expected days
Under half of billed by the term end

probability._about: Churn-or-downsell probability within horizon_days: logistic regression on the feature risks (0-1), shrunk toward an expert prior built from the scorecard weights. With few outcomes the prior dominates; as outcomes accumulate the data takes over.

backtest._about: Walk-forward: retrain every train_every_days once min_train_days of history exist; training uses one snapshot per customer every train_sample_days (weekly snapshots of one customer are not independent); top_share = the share of customers flagged when measuring precision.
